title: TASO: Jailbreak LLMs via Alternative Template and Suffix Optimization
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development and evaluation of a jailbreak method (TASO) against LLM safety filters. While it uses safety benchmarks like HarmBench to test whether models can be induced to provide harmful/illegal content, it does not evaluate religious beliefs, moral reasoning, or ethical philosophical frameworks such as deontology or utilitarianism.
